localizations.description:
Train smart, your way.

Build workouts around your goals, equipment and recent training. Log every set, see estimated muscle recovery, and keep nutrition and sleep in view.

• AI Coach that listens. Tell it your goals, available time and equipment. Create a plan, refine it in chat, and choose which preferences to remember.
• A clearer view of recovery. Explore your muscles in 3D and see training-based recovery estimates and exercises for each muscle.
• Focus on your workout. Log weight and reps, use rest timers, and follow your session on Apple Watch or Live Activities.
• Progress you can see. Compare lifts, review muscle training volume and revisit your workout history.
• Nutrition without the fuss. Describe a meal or add a photo to estimate protein, carbohydrates and fat against your personal targets.
• Sleep in context. Connect Apple Health to see sleep duration, stages and progress toward your chosen sleep target.
• Your day at a glance. Combine Workout, Diet and Sleep in one calendar, with widgets for your Home Screen.

Complete workouts, history, basic charts and data export stay available. Free: 5 plans and 3 custom exercises. Existing plans, exercises and acquired results remain usable after Pro expires. 

Masso Pro: Ongoing AI adjustments, more saved plans and custom exercises, lift progress and detailed recovery estimates.

 AI allowances are stored only on this device installation. Changing devices or reinstalling may reset them; they are not shared across devices. Each supported AI task has one successful free experience on this installation. Free also includes 2 shared text tasks per calendar month (UTC). Repeat images and ongoing reviews need Pro. A task includes 2 same-goal adjustments within 24 hours. Failed requests, clarification, local tools and reopening saved results do not use the allowance. Existing users have 30 days from this notice before the new AI limits apply. Previous use is not counted retroactively. Eligible subscribers can receive a 7-day free trial when offered. Apple shows eligibility, price and billing period before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled; manage them in your Apple account settings.

AI features require internet access and your permission to share relevant data with our AI provider. Meal nutrients and recovery are estimates, not medical measurements or medical advice. Sleep stages require compatible Apple Health data.
